result.title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
result.summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT, a large-scale Character-centric dataset and benchmark covering diverse Large-Angle Camera Trajectories, with accurate camera geometry and multi-view character observations for training and evaluation. We further propose WorldCast, a framework for world-consistent character video generation under diverse large-angle camera motions. Specifically, we back-project the initial frame into a 3D point cloud using estimated depth, align the point-cloud scale with the target camera trajectory, and render it along the trajectory to obtain explicit geometric guidance and coverage masks. To complement the incomplete character information, we introduce Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA). Using relative camera poses estimated jointly from the initial frame and multi-view character anchors, we express anchor and target-view geometry in a common coordinate frame. GAMA uses this geometric alignment to guide the retrieval and injection of view-relevant character features during generation. Evaluations across diverse large-angle camera trajectories demonstrate accurate trajectory following while preserving character geometry, appearance, and identity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 WorldCast：用初始帧反投影点云沿目标相机轨迹渲染，给出显式几何引导与覆盖掩码，并设计几何对齐的记忆注意力，从多视角角色锚点按位姿检索视图相关特征，实现大角度相机控制的角色视频生成，同时构建 CLACT 数据集与基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 覆盖掩码显式区分已观测与不可见区域，几何对齐的检索按位姿选择视图相关特征，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及位置、深度敏感的 latent 注意力结构提供可供核查的线索，但其三维对齐能否用于推理状态的特征读取尚需确认。
